name: Docketline
summary: A fictional intake and conflict checklist. Sample data for the legal directory.
paragraphs: Docketline, in this sample, asks a new client the facts a file needs and runs a conflict checklist before anyone opens a matter. The name is a placeholder.
The useful test for a real intake tool is whether the first conversation gets shorter and whether conflicts surface before work starts. This listing does not claim that result for a real product.
whyItMatters: Unpaid intake time is a quiet leak. A checklist that collects the facts once can return those hours to work the firm can bill.
pricing: Sample pricing, not a live offer.
bestFor: Readers checking how an intake listing is written.
